crossRefs.note: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

parallels.note: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

translations.web: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
translations.bsb: In the synagogue there was a man possessed by the spirit of an unclean demon. He cried out in a loud voice,
translations.kjv: And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice,
translations.asv: And in the synagogue there was a man, that had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,
